scope: Independent read-only runtime source and existing native recovery trace audit; no additional native jobs or source changes.

source_review.atomic_publication: All flags, raw progression, clocks, boundary, reward, metadata, RGB and info conversions precede wrapper state commit.
source_review.failure_behavior: Public invalidate marks coordinator broken and records durable typed error; wrapper enters NEEDS_RECOVERY before recording; step/reset retries reject before dispatch.
source_review.recovery_behavior: Both workers stop and restart, new episode validated before commit; counters persist and actor-memory reset signal is explicit.
source_review.iwad_behavior: Explicit selection with pinned hash; path readback before and after init, rehash after init and provenance returned from worker snapshots.
source_review.port_behavior: Cross-process advisory lease held for engine lifetime, actual UDP availability checked before releasing bind socket; fixed-port collision fails and recognized automatic-port collision retries are bounded.

limits: Live trace audits one injected RGB-conversion failure; other failure classes are covered by the recorded unit suite.
Worker instance identities come from native get_instance_id values recorded by recovery smoke; they are not independently logged in each acknowledgement.
Native ledger does not record chosen network port numbers; real occupied-port and cross-process exclusion are covered by the recorded coordinator unit tests.
Full acceptance campaign was still in progress when this runtime-only audit was written.
evidence_report_status_at_audit_note: The parent verification was still in progress; its conservative initial status is failed until every gate completes. This was not a completed failed run.
